eval.description: Run the offline synthetic opportunity eval suite.
eval.template: Run `npm run eval`, inspect mismatches, and report scoring regressions without changing files unless asked.

review-opportunity.description: Score a pasted or fixture-based opportunity against the rubric.
review-opportunity.template: Review the opportunity in $ARGUMENTS using config/scoring-rubric.json. Record evidence, risk flags, missing information, score, and decision. Do not browse unless the user explicitly authorizes a visible browser session.

planner.description: Planning-only agent for CareerDeepSeek architecture and workflow changes.

scorer.description: Scores job opportunities using the public rubric and synthetic fixtures.

reviewer.description: Reviews scoring results, privacy boundaries, and proposed prompt or rubric changes.
